description: This source file defines the GatewayRemoteConfig enum with static methods for resolving and normalizing remote gateway configurations, such as transport type, URL strings, tokens, and gateway URLs in the context of OpenClaw project.

methods.name: resolveTransport
methods.description: Resolves the remote transport type (direct or ssh) from the provided root dictionary.

methods.name: resolveUrlString
methods.description: Extracts and trims the URL string from the remote configuration.

methods.name: resolveTokenValue
methods.description: Resolves the token value from the remote configuration, classifying it as missing, unsupported, or plaintext.

methods.name: resolveTokenString
methods.description: Gets the token string if available and valid from the token value.

methods.name: resolveGatewayUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL object for the gateway URL after normalization.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayUrlString
methods.description: Normalizes a raw URL string and returns its absolute string form.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a URL, verifying scheme, host, and port constraints.

methods.name: defaultPort
methods.description: Provides default port numbers based on URL scheme for WebSocket connections.
